claims.claim: Sanmina's acquired ZT Systems manufacturing business adds large U.S. AI/data-center manufacturing facilities, advanced liquid-cooling capability and a preferred NPI relationship with AMD for rack- and cluster-scale AI systems.
By fiscal Q3 2026 Sanmina reported more customer orders across both core Sanmina and ZT Systems, added capacity and additional vertical-integration synergies.

factors.name: AI infrastructure manufacturing exposure
factors.basis: ZT materially expands full-system integration and hyperscale infrastructure manufacturing capability.

factors.name: vertical integration
factors.basis: Management reported capacity expansion and synergy progress after the acquisition.

risks.risk: Cloud/AI infrastructure concentration and acquisition integration increase customer, cycle and execution sensitivity.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run margin profile and customer concentration of the combined ZT business require deeper underwriting.

claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was $3.46B, GAAP operating margin 6.4%, non-GAAP operating margin 8.0%, and operating cash flow $124M; revenue was at the high end of outlook and non-GAAP margin/EPS exceeded outlook.
Sanmina raised fiscal-2026 revenue guidance to $14.0B-$14.3B and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $11.90-$12.20, while describing strong demand into fiscal 2027 and 2028.

factors.name: guidance conversion
factors.basis: Raised full-year revenue/margin/EPS outlook after Q3 outperformance.

factors.name: cash conversion
factors.basis: Operating cash flow remained positive but Q3 free cash flow was only $24M amid investment.

risks.risk: Forward demand claims remain exposed to hyperscaler capex, customer concentration, tariffs/trade policy and integration execution.

unknowns.unknown: Fiscal Q4 outcome is not yet available in the cited evidence window.
